blocks.text: Numbers 23 contains 30 verses. It opens with: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams. It concludes with: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bullock and a ram on every altar. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: In Numbers 22-24, Balak summons Balaam to curse Israel, but Balaam repeatedly delivers blessings under divine constraint. The Deir Alla inscription attests a later nonbiblical tradition about Balaam son of Beor, but it does not independently verify the speeches or events narrated in Numbers 22-24.
